newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Courthouse TV for S.Africans awaiting trial.
newsitem.headline: Courthouse TV for S.Africans awaiting trial.

text.p: Crime-ridden South Africa is to install television sets in its courthouses in an effort to educate the public about the law, Justice Minister Dullah Omar said on Tuesday.
"The aim will not be to entertain the public, but to inform and educate them while they wait to be called into court," he told parliament.
President Nelson Mandela's government has been hard-pressed to deal with a violent crime wave since it won power in the country's first all-race elections in 1994.
Omar said his department had considered sponsoring a local television programme along the lines of the U.S. television series L.A. Law, but this had proved too expensive.
